decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in 2024 and builds on the firm's established market-data base, so it is cheap to keep and its value remains promising and uncertain.
Its demotion to a mere mention signals weaker prospects, but the calculator sits close to the core tariff data business and costs little to maintain, so the option is kept open for another period.
The area definition tool was also downgraded to a mention, yet it likely supports other location-based products on the platform at low marginal cost, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
